landing.title: Build React apps out of self-contained feature modules
landing.subtitle: Each feature declares its routes, navigation, permissions and translations. The app assembles them. Tailwind CSS v4, shadcn/ui and a live theme engine included.

modules.title: Feature modules
modules.description: Add a folder, register one line: routes, sidebar, ⌘K and i18n are wired up for you.

theme.title: Live theme engine
theme.description: Light/dark, presets, any brand color, radius, font and density. Export the result as CSS.

contracts.title: Typed API contracts
contracts.description: Every response is validated with Zod, so backend drift fails loudly in one place.

access.title: Roles & policies
access.description: Guards for routes, role-filtered navigation and per-resource policies.

quality.title: Enforced architecture
quality.description: Lint rules keep layers one-way; tests cover modules, translations and flows.

dx.title: Batteries included
dx.description: Mock API, generators, CI, Docker, i18n, E2E tests and a command palette.

theme.description: Changes are saved on this device and applied instantly.
theme.copied: Theme CSS copied to the clipboard
